jurisdictions.label: Cities
jurisdictions.description: Incorporated cities and towns (2024 Census places)
jurisdictions.aoi: SELECT DISTINCT h3_cell_to_parent(c, 0) AS h0, c AS h8 FROM (SELECT unnest(h3_uncompact_cells(list(cell), 8)) AS c FROM read_parquet('{{SITE}}/data/aoi/city-r8.parquet') WHERE id = '{{ID}}')
jurisdictions.aoi10: SELECT DISTINCT h3_cell_to_parent(c, 0) AS h0, h3_cell_to_parent(c, 8) AS h8, c AS h10 FROM (SELECT unnest(h3_uncompact_cells(list(cell), 10)) AS c FROM read_parquet('{{SITE}}/data/aoi/city.parquet') WHERE id = '{{ID}}')
jurisdictions.cells10: SELECT DISTINCT GEOID AS id, h0, h10 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-census/census-2024/place/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') WHERE STATEFP = '06' AND CLASSFP LIKE 'C%'
jurisdictions.list: SELECT GEOID AS id, NAME AS name, CASE WHEN LSAD = '43' THEN 'town' ELSE 'city' END AS detail, ST_XMin(geom) AS xmin, ST_YMin(geom) AS ymin, ST_XMax(geom) AS xmax, ST_YMax(geom) AS ymax FROM read_parquet('s3://public-census/census-2024/place.parquet') WHERE STATEFP = '06' AND CLASSFP LIKE 'C%' ORDER BY NAME
